observations.why: The 'we' pronoun enacts communal-sharing — the team as an undifferentiated body that shipped together — rather than attributing the act to an individual.
Velocity measured in points is a proportional, cost-benefit metric — market-pricing framing of team output.
Naming an integration as 'the key unlock' frames it as a shared enabler of collective progress — communal-sharing cast as a single lever for the whole team.
